output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    if h>=w: return g
    # extrapolate repeating two-row motif: singleton diagonal, then adjacent pair one column left
    color=next((v for row in g for v in row if v),0)
    while len(g)<w:
        k=len(g)
        # singleton on diagonal progression, alternating with pair
        c=(k+1)//2
        if k%2==0:
            row=[0]*w
            if c<w: row[c]=color
        else:
            row=[0]*w
            if c-1>=0: row[c-1]=color
            if c<w: row[c]=color
        g.append(row)
    return g"}

{"code":"def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    if h>=w:return g
    nz=[(i,j,v) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v]
    color=nz[0][2] if nz else 0
    cols={j for i,j,v in nz}
    if len(cols)==1:
        c=next(iter(cols))
        while len(g)<w:
            r=[0]*w;r[c]=color;g.append(r)
        return g
    while len(g)<w:
        k=len(g); c=(k+1)//2; r=[0]*w
        if k%2==0:r[c]=color
        else:r[c-1]=color;r[c]=color
        g.append(r)
    return g"}
